name: MV Rozi
description: Former Grand Harbour tug, about 35 m long, scuttled off Ċirkewwa in 1992, first for tourist submarine trips and now one of Malta's best-known dives. Upright on sand roughly 130 m from the entry, the mast starting at 20 m and the hull mostly at 30–34 m. Intact apart from the engine and propeller, with several places to look inside. Often combined with the P29 or the Arch.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
